additional_info.subject: ID0464286-DC/Si-D/ES-[Y2/S3 300000004065] OCPP logs issue CRM:03209000002
additional_info.body:
Dear Roberto,
We checked both chargers, and there is a difference in OCPP configurations.
The one that is working:
As you can see the backend is requesting all these parameters.
And here is the charger with the problem:
As you can see there are several parameters missing.
You need to ask the backend provider to send the same configuration to this charger, as we can not do this change from our side.
Since this is not a charger related problem, we will wait for your feedback and close the ticket afterwards.
Best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
